goal: Master L01 for Chinese UAV algorithm interview

cards.think1: Vertical component holds weight mg = T cos(theta); horizontal component accelerates mass m a = T sin(theta).
cards.feedback: Good derivation of lateral acceleration from tilt angle.

openQuestions: Chinese: 速度环 vs 角速度环: Rate loop is 角速度环 (angular rate), 速度环 is the velocity loop. Order A是B的C now correct.
giving the number: Wrote formulas without computing (g*tan25 = 4.57 m/s^2, theta = 11.5 deg, phi = 90 deg). Always finish with number + unit.
force vs acceleration units: Grill Q1/Q6: labelled 15.66 N as m/s^2 and 4.905 N as metres. Carry units: N / (N/m) = m, so sag = 4.905/6 = 0.82 m.
sanity check before finishing: Grill Q1: fed T into the 3-D formula (27.71 N). Holding height means vertical part = weight = 14.72 N; correct T 15.66 N, horizontal 5.36 N, a 3.57 m/s^2.

content.text: Lesson L01 (四旋翼怎么飞): focus on thrust vector decomposition, cascade PID inner/outer loops, and integral steady-state error removal.

nodes.title: Rotor thrust and hover balance (T = mg)

Cascade control loops (位置环 -> 速度环 -> 姿态环 -> 角速度环)
Payload disturbance and integral term (积分项消除稳态误差)
